def safe(v, default=np.nan):
    return float(v) if v is not None else default

def feats(hist):
    # hist list dicts without core
    t=np.array([r['time_min'] for r in hist],float)
    t0=t[0]; el=t-t0; elapsed=el[-1]
    def col(name):
        return np.array([safe(r.get(name)) for r in hist],float)
    hr=col('hr'); skin=col('skin_temp'); watts=col('watts'); amb=col('ambient_temp'); hum=col('humidity')
    last=hist[-1]
    age=safe(last.get('age')); mass=safe(last.get('mass')); height=safe(last.get('height'))
    bmi=mass/((height/100)**2) if mass and height else np.nan
    bsa=math.sqrt(height*mass/3600) if mass and height else np.nan
    def lastv(x):
        v=x[~np.isnan(x)]; return v[-1] if len(v) else np.nan
    def firstv(x):
        v=x[~np.isnan(x)]; return v[0] if len(v) else np.nan
    def meanv(x): return np.nanmean(x) if np.any(~np.isnan(x)) else np.nan
    def stdv(x): return np.nanstd(x) if np.sum(~np.isnan(x))>1 else 0.0
    def slope(x):
        m=~np.isnan(x)
        if m.sum()<2 or np.std(el[m])==0: return 0.0
        return float(np.polyfit(el[m], x[m],1)[0])
    def recent(x,k):
        return meanv(x[-k:])
    def ema(x,tau):
        # last ema value ignoring nan, time weighted
        v=np.nan; last_t=0
        for xi,ti in zip(x,el):
            if np.isnan(xi): continue
            if np.isnan(v): v=xi
            else:
                a=1-math.exp(-(ti-last_t)/tau) if tau>0 else 1
                v+=a*(xi-v)
            last_t=ti
        return v
    def integral(x):
        # trapz ignoring nan fill interp
        m=~np.isnan(x)
        if m.sum()<2: return 0.0
        xi=np.interp(el, el[m], x[m])
        return float(np.trapz(xi, el))
    f={}
    f['elapsed']=elapsed; f['n']=len(hist); f['age']=age; f['mass']=mass; f['height']=height; f['bmi']=bmi; f['bsa']=bsa
    for name,x in [('hr',hr),('skin',skin),('watts',watts),('amb',amb),('hum',hum)]:
        f[name+'_last']=lastv(x); f[name+'_first']=firstv(x); f[name+'_mean']=meanv(x); f[name+'_std']=stdv(x); f[name+'_slope']=slope(x)
        f[name+'_min']=np.nanmin(x) if np.any(~np.isnan(x)) else np.nan
        f[name+'_max']=np.nanmax(x) if np.any(~np.isnan(x)) else np.nan
        f[name+'_r5']=recent(x,5); f[name+'_r10']=recent(x,10); f[name+'_r20']=recent(x,20)
        f[name+'_ema5']=ema(x,5); f[name+'_ema15']=ema(x,15)
        f[name+'_int']=integral(x)
        f[name+'_delta']=lastv(x)-firstv(x)
    f['watts_per_kg']=lastv(watts)/mass if mass else np.nan
    f['watts_mean_per_kg']=meanv(watts)/mass if mass else np.nan
    f['cumwatts_per_kg']=integral(watts)/mass if mass else np.nan
    f['cumwatts_per_bsa']=integral(watts)/bsa if bsa else np.nan
    f['cum_hr_excess']=integral(np.where(np.isnan(hr),np.nan,hr-100))
    f['hr_pct_max']=lastv(hr)/(220-age) if age else np.nan
    f['hr_mean_pct_max']=meanv(hr)/(220-age) if age else np.nan
    f['skin_minus_amb']=lastv(skin)-lastv(amb)
    f['skin_mean_minus_amb_mean']=meanv(skin)-meanv(amb)
    f['elapsed_x_wattskg']=elapsed*f['watts_mean_per_kg']
    f['sqrt_elapsed']=math.sqrt(elapsed)
    f['log_elapsed']=math.log1p(elapsed)
    return f

# build dataset LOPO samples: every time point as request history upto that point
persons=sorted(train.keys())
allX={}; ally={}
feat_names=None
for pid in persons:
    rows=train[pid]
    X=[]; y=[]
    for i,r in enumerate(rows):

        hist=[{k:v for k,v in rr.items() if k!='core_temp'} for rr in rows[:i+1]]

import math, numpy as np

def _safe(v):
    return float(v) if v is not None else float('nan')

def extract(hist):
    t=np.array([r['time_min'] for r in hist],float)
    t0=t[0]; el=t-t0; elapsed=float(el[-1])
    def col(name): return np.array([_safe(r.get(name)) for r in hist],float)
    hr=col('hr'); skin=col('skin_temp'); watts=col('watts'); amb=col('ambient_temp'); hum=col('humidity')
    last=hist[-1]
    age=_safe(last.get('age')); mass=_safe(last.get('mass')); height=_safe(last.get('height'))
    bmi=mass/((height/100)**2) if mass>0 and height>0 else np.nan
    bsa=math.sqrt(height*mass/3600) if mass>0 and height>0 else np.nan
    def lastv(x):
        v=x[~np.isnan(x)]; return float(v[-1]) if len(v) else np.nan
    def firstv(x):
        v=x[~np.isnan(x)]; return float(v[0]) if len(v) else np.nan
    def meanv(x): return float(np.nanmean(x)) if np.any(~np.isnan(x)) else np.nan
    def stdv(x): return float(np.nanstd(x)) if np.sum(~np.isnan(x))>1 else 0.0
    def slope(x):
        m=~np.isnan(x)
        if m.sum()<3 or np.std(el[m])==0: return 0.0
        return float(np.polyfit(el[m], x[m],1)[0])
    def recent(x,k): return meanv(x[-k:])
    def ema(x,tau):
        v=np.nan; last_t=0.0
        for xi,ti in zip(x,el):
            if np.isnan(xi): continue
            if np.isnan(v): v=xi
            else:
                a=1-math.exp(-max(ti-last_t,0)/tau) if tau>0 else 1.0
                v+=a*(xi-v)
            last_t=ti
        return float(v) if not np.isnan(v) else np.nan
    def integral(x):
        m=~np.isnan(x)
        if m.sum()<2: return float(elapsed*firstv(x)) if m.sum()==1 else 0.0
        xi=np.interp(el, el[m], x[m])
        return float(np.trapezoid(xi, el))
    def decay_int(x,tau):
        # integral x(s)*exp(-(elapsed-s)/tau) ds approx trapz
        m=~np.isnan(x)
        if m.sum()==0: return np.nan
        xi=np.interp(el, el[m], x[m]) if m.sum()>1 else np.full_like(el, x[m][0])
        w=np.exp(-(elapsed-el)/tau)
        return float(np.trapezoid(xi*w, el))
    def window_mean(x, lo_frac, hi_frac):
        if elapsed==0: return meanv(x)
        m=(el>=lo_frac*elapsed)&(el<=hi_frac*elapsed) if hi_frac<1 else (el>=lo_frac*elapsed)
        return meanv(x[m]) if np.any(m) else np.nan
    f={}
    f['elapsed']=elapsed; f['n']=float(len(hist)); f['age']=age; f['mass']=mass; f['height']=height; f['bmi']=float(bmi); f['bsa']=float(bsa)
    f['elapsed2']=elapsed**2; f['elapsed_sqrt']=math.sqrt(elapsed); f['elapsed_log']=math.log1p(elapsed)
    cols=[('hr',hr),('skin',skin),('watts',watts),('amb',amb),('hum',hum)]
    for name,x in cols:
        f[name+'_last']=lastv(x); f[name+'_first']=firstv(x); f[name+'_mean']=meanv(x); f[name+'_std']=stdv(x); f[name+'_slope']=slope(x)
        f[name+'_min']=float(np.nanmin(x)) if np.any(~np.isnan(x)) else np.nan
        f[name+'_max']=float(np.nanmax(x)) if np.any(~np.isnan(x)) else np.nan
        f[name+'_r3']=recent(x,3); f[name+'_r5']=recent(x,5); f[name+'_r10']=recent(x,10); f[name+'_r20']=recent(x,20)
        f[name+'_ema5']=ema(x,5); f[name+'_ema15']=ema(x,15); f[name+'_ema30']=ema(x,30)
        f[name+'_int']=integral(x); f[name+'_delta']=lastv(x)-firstv(x)
        f[name+'_w_first_third']=window_mean(x,0,0.34); f[name+'_w_mid_third']=window_mean(x,0.34,0.67); f[name+'_w_last_third']=window_mean(x,0.67,1.01)
        f[name+'_decay10']=decay_int(x,10); f[name+'_decay20']=decay_int(x,20); f[name+'_decay40']=decay_int(x,40)
        f[name+'_missfrac']=float(np.mean(np.isnan(x)))
    # derived
    mw=meanv(watts); mh=meanv(hr); ms=meanv(skin)
    f['watts_per_kg']=lastv(watts)/mass if mass>0 else np.nan
    f['watts_mean_per_kg']=mw/mass if mass>0 else np.nan
    f['watts_per_bsa']=mw/bsa if bsa>0 else np.nan
    f['cumwatts_per_kg']=integral(watts)/mass if mass>0 else np.nan
    f['cumwatts_per_bsa']=integral(watts)/bsa if bsa>0 else np.nan
    f['hr_pct_max']=lastv(hr)/(220-age) if age>0 else np.nan
    f['hr_mean_pct_max']=mh/(220-age) if age>0 else np.nan
    f['hr_reserve_proxy']=lastv(hr)-70
    f['skin_minus_amb']=lastv(skin)-lastv(amb)
    f['skin_mean_minus_amb_mean']=ms-meanv(amb)
    f['core_skin_gap_proxy']=lastv(skin)  # placeholder dup removed later
    # interactions with elapsed (and elapsed2 scaled)
    base={
        'hr_mean':mh,'hr_last':lastv(hr),'hr_ema15':ema(hr,15),'skin_mean':ms,'skin_last':lastv(skin),'skin_first':firstv(skin),
        'watts_mean':mw,'watts_perkg_mean':f['watts_mean_per_kg'],'amb_mean':meanv(amb),'hum_mean':meanv(hum),
        'age':age,'mass':mass,'bmi':float(bmi),'hr_pct_mean':f['hr_mean_pct_max'],'skin_amb_diff':f['skin_mean_minus_amb_mean']
    }
    for k,v in base.items():
        f['el_x_'+k]=elapsed*v
        f['el2_x_'+k]=elapsed*elapsed*v/100.0
        f['sqrtel_x_'+k]=math.sqrt(elapsed)*v
    f['hr_drift']=lastv(hr)-f['hr_w_first_third'] if not np.isnan(f['hr_w_first_third']) else np.nan
    f['skin_drift']=lastv(skin)-firstv(skin)
    f['hr_slope_x_el']=slope(hr)*elapsed
    f['skin_slope_x_el']=slope(skin)*elapsed
    # heat stress indices approx
    f['amb_x_hum']=meanv(amb)*meanv(hum)
    f['watts_x_amb']=mw*meanv(amb)
    f['hr_x_skin']=mh*ms
    return f

# --- append v2 features by wrapping extract ---
_orig_extract = extract
def extract(hist):
    f = _orig_extract(hist)
    import math as _m
    elapsed = f['elapsed']
    # basis functions
    for tau in (8,15,25,40,70):
        f[f'basis_exp_{tau}'] = 1-_m.exp(-elapsed/tau) if elapsed>=0 else 0.0
        # interact with key means
        for k in ('hr_mean','watts_mean_per_kg','skin_mean','amb_mean','hum_mean'):
            v=f.get(k, float('nan'))
            f[f'basis{tau}_x_{k}'] = (1-_m.exp(-elapsed/tau))*v
    f['bsa_per_mass'] = f['bsa']/f['mass'] if f.get('mass') else float('nan')
    f['mass_per_bsa'] = f['mass']/f['bsa'] if f.get('bsa') else float('nan')
    f['watts_per_hr'] = f['watts_mean']/f['hr_mean'] if f.get('hr_mean') else float('nan')
    f['hr_per_watt'] = f['hr_mean']/f['watts_mean'] if f.get('watts_mean') else float('nan')
    f['wattskg_per_hrpct'] = f['watts_mean_per_kg']/f['hr_mean_pct_max'] if f.get('hr_mean_pct_max') else float('nan')
    # wet bulb approx (Stull) using mean amb/hum
    T=f.get('amb_mean'); RH=f.get('hum_mean')
    if T is not None and RH is not None and not (isinstance(T,float) and _m.isnan(T)):
        try:
            tw = T*_m.atan(0.151977*_m.sqrt(RH+8.313659)) + _m.atan(T+RH) - _m.atan(RH-1.676331) + 0.00391838*(RH**1.5)*_m.atan(0.023101*RH) - 4.686035
        except Exception:
            tw=float('nan')
    else:
        tw=float('nan')
    f['wetbulb_mean']=tw
    f['amb_minus_wetbulb']= (T-tw) if tw==tw and T==T else float('nan')
    f['skin_minus_wetbulb']= f['skin_mean']-tw if tw==tw else float('nan')
    # HR drift normalized
    f['hr_drift_per_el'] = f['hr_drift']/(elapsed+5.0)
    f['skin_hr_ratio']= f['skin_mean']/f['hr_mean'] if f.get('hr_mean') else float('nan')
    f['el_x_bsa_per_mass']=elapsed*f['bsa_per_mass']
    f['el_x_watts_per_hr']=elapsed*f['watts_per_hr'] if f['watts_per_hr']==f['watts_per_hr'] else float('nan')
    return f

    if taus: used=used+[f'exp_decay_{t}' for t in taus]

## Frozen predictor

`submission.py` is a self-contained, pure-standard-library predictor (only `math` is imported). It is stateless: each call uses only the history supplied in that request.

It is an equal-weight average of three linear models, all trained only on the 14 labelled people in `train.json` and converted to raw-unit coefficients with training-set median imputation embedded in the file:

1. **Lasso** ($\alpha=0.002$) on a full causal summary of the history.
2. **Ridge** ($\alpha=30$) on exponential-moving-average features.
3. **Ridge** ($\alpha=10$) on 30-minute EMA features plus $\exp(-\text{elapsed}/10)$ and $\exp(-\text{elapsed}/30)$ terms.

### Causal inputs used
Only past/current history, summarised as: elapsed time relative to the first supplied timestamp; last/first/mean/SD/slope, recent-window, EMA-5/15/30, cumulative (trapezoid) and decayed integrals, first/middle/last-third means, and missing fractions for HR, skin temperature, watts, ambient temperature and humidity; age, mass, height, BMI and body-surface area; watts/kg and watts/BSA; HR as a fraction of $220-\text{age}$; skin-minus-ambient differences; and elapsed-time interactions with the main HR/skin/watts/ambient/humidity summaries. The mean is clipped to 35.5–40.5 °C.

No core temperature is available at prediction time, no person identity lookup is used, and **no absolute clock time is used** — I verified that adding 1000 minutes to every timestamp gives an identical prediction, as required for the independently shifted hidden clocks. Missing values are handled by the embedded medians, and an empty history falls back to 37.3 °C.

## Development evidence (actually run)

- Template/ECTemp-style baseline (`template.py` copied to `submission.py` first): dev person-balanced **MAE 0.388**, coverage 0.717 at ±0.5 °C.
- Leave-one-person-out on the 14 training people (840 minute rows, 836 labelled): baseline 0.532; full Lasso 0.230; EMA-Ridge 0.249; EMA30+decay Ridge 0.241; the frozen three-model average **0.225**. Errors were dominated by a per-person intercept bias (up to about ±0.6 °C), which motivated keeping models simple and averaged.
- Single-model dev checks along the way: Lasso alone 0.401 (one dev person, H17, at 0.824); EMA-Ridge alone 0.362 (H17 at 0.953); Lasso+EMA30-decay 0.368. I retained the three-model average because it was best in training LOPO and its dev result was essentially tied with the best single model.
- **Final frozen submission, verified with `dev_score`:** person-balanced **MAE 0.365** on 300 dev requests (per-person: H08 0.164, H17 0.898, H20 0.206, H21 0.276, H24 0.283), hot-request MAE 0.177, 90% interval coverage 0.883, interval score 2.357.
- Runtime check: all 300 dev 3B requests predicted in about 0.3 s locally.

## Uncertainty
The returned interval is a constant `mean − 0.80 °C` to `mean + 0.70 °C` (width 1.5 °C, within the 5 °C limit). Training LOPO residuals had 5th/95th percentiles of about −0.59/+0.51 °C for the averaged model; I widened the interval somewhat because held-out people showed larger systematic offsets. This raised dev coverage from ~0.80 (at −0.58/+0.50) to 0.883 and improved the dev interval score from ~2.53 to 2.36, at the cost of a wider interval.

## Limitations
- Training data are only 14 people with strongly within-person-correlated minutes, so person-level generalisation — especially each new person's unknown starting core temperature, fitness and other unmeasured traits — remains the main error source. This is visible in dev person H17 (MAE 0.898), whom all trained variants over-predicted even though the other four dev people were predicted at 0.16–0.28 °C.
- Ambient temperature and humidity vary over only a narrow range in training, there are a few noisy/erratic labelled core points late in some training sessions (e.g. abrupt drops/spikes), and the interval is not adaptive to elapsed time or to the individual, so exact 90% coverage on new people is not guaranteed.
- The predictor estimates current (3B) core temperature; it applies no +15-minute forecast adjustment for 3A-style requests.
